lore3026_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [affectionate] [sincere] I am glad you came. We can call tonight a celebration if you like, but I would be just as happy sharing a plain supper and hearing about your day.
lore3026_befriended_1.ogg.text: I am glad you came. We can call tonight a celebration if you like, but I would be just as happy sharing a plain supper and hearing about your day.

lore3026_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [cheerful] There you are! I have packed something for the road. I was going to give it a magnificent name, but I thought we had better taste it first.
lore3026_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are! I have packed something for the road. I was going to give it a magnificent name, but I thought we had better taste it first.

lore3026_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [amused] [fond] I announced a grand feast once, just to get everyone to sit down. It was stew. Nobody complained, and several people stayed long enough to help with the washing up.
lore3026_idle_1.ogg.text: I announced a grand feast once, just to get everyone to sit down. It was stew. Nobody complained, and several people stayed long enough to help with the washing up.

lore3026_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [patient] [encouraging] Start with a fire you can cook over, then give the food your attention. There will be time for elaborate recipes. A simple meal done well is already worth learning.
lore3026_learned_1.ogg.text: Start with a fire you can cook over, then give the food your attention. There will be time for elaborate recipes. A simple meal done well is already worth learning.

lore3062_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm sincere affection, calm confidence, openly pleased] I would be glad to share your path for a while. Tell me what has stayed with you from the day. A lesson, a worry, or something that made you smile. Good company leaves room for all of them, and I have come to value yours.
lore3062_befriended_1.ogg.text: I would be glad to share your path for a while. Tell me what has stayed with you from the day. A lesson, a worry, or something that made you smile. Good company leaves room for all of them, and I have come to value yours.

lore3062_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [rich low feminine warmth, grounded welcome, softly amused] Welcome, friend. Come and tell me what you have learned since we last spoke. There is time to listen. If you notice my foot tapping, I have a small rhythm caught in my thoughts. It may escape the moment I try to explain it.
lore3062_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome, friend. Come and tell me what you have learned since we last spoke. There is time to listen. If you notice my foot tapping, I have a small rhythm caught in my thoughts. It may escape the moment I try to explain it.

lore3062_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [earthy feminine contralto, reflective pleasure, gentle humor] I like listening to rain on the tent. A few drops find a rhythm, and I try following it with my foot. Then the pattern changes, and I have to begin again. It is a pleasant way to discover how quickly certainty can turn into laughter.
lore3062_idle_1.ogg.text: I like listening to rain on the tent. A few drops find a rhythm, and I try following it with my foot. Then the pattern changes, and I have to begin again. It is a pleasant way to discover how quickly certainty can turn into laughter.

lore3062_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [low feminine encouraging teacher, patient, practical warmth] You have taken another step. Give yourself time to understand it, and bring me the questions that follow. I hope each lesson leaves you better prepared, but you need not pretend that learning is finished. We can speak again, and look at what experience has shown you.
lore3062_learned_1.ogg.text: You have taken another step. Give yourself time to understand it, and bring me the questions that follow. I hope each lesson leaves you better prepared, but you need not pretend that learning is finished. We can speak again, and look at what experience has shown you.

lore3064_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere calm affection, gentle gratitude, contented warmth] I would be happy to accompany you. We have spent enough time speaking of what must be learned; I have also come to enjoy the person doing the learning. Let us share a little of the road as friends. There need not be another task at the end of every conversation.
lore3064_befriended_1.ogg.text: I would be happy to accompany you. We have spent enough time speaking of what must be learned; I have also come to enjoy the person doing the learning. Let us share a little of the road as friends. There need not be another task at the end of every conversation.

lore3064_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [patient grounded welcome, warm curiosity, unhurried kindness] Come, let us walk together. There is always more to notice than a lesson has time to contain. You may tell me what has been occupying your thoughts, or we can enjoy a quiet stretch of the path. Your company need not arrive carrying a question to be welcome.
lore3064_greet_1.ogg.text: Come, let us walk together. There is always more to notice than a lesson has time to contain. You may tell me what has been occupying your thoughts, or we can enjoy a quiet stretch of the path. Your company need not arrive carrying a question to be welcome.

lore3064_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle playful amusement, quietly delighted, relaxed warmth] That cloud has the look of a sleeping bear. There, with its nose tucked in. You see only a hill? That is quite all right. It is a small pleasure of mine, not a test of your wisdom. The sky may keep its clouds, and I may keep my bears.
lore3064_idle_1.ogg.text: That cloud has the look of a sleeping bear. There, with its nose tucked in. You see only a hill? That is quite all right. It is a small pleasure of mine, not a test of your wisdom. The sky may keep its clouds, and I may keep my bears.

lore3064_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtful encouraging instruction, steady confidence, generous warmth] Give yourself time to understand what you have learned. A lesson is more than the words we can repeat afterward. Consider what it asks of your actions, and where another teacher may help you see farther. That is part of why I send learners onward when they are ready.

lore3884_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [open sincere friendship, affectionate pleasure, mellow warmth] I would enjoy that. We have shared enough pleasant moments that I look forward to the next one, even before I know what we will be doing. You need not arrive hungry or carrying an errand to have my company. Come, let us find a little time to spend together, and perhaps somewhere nice to sit.
lore3884_befriended_1.ogg.text: I would enjoy that. We have shared enough pleasant moments that I look forward to the next one, even before I know what we will be doing. You need not arrive hungry or carrying an errand to have my company. Come, let us find a little time to spend together, and perhaps somewhere nice to sit.

lore3884_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm welcoming practicality, gentle good humor, relaxed affection] Good to see you. Shall we take something to eat before we go? I would rather share a loaf along the way than discover you have spent the whole walk hungry. We can find a pleasant place to stop. There is no need to save every good part of the day until the work is finished.

lore3884_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [contented conversational warmth, mild amusement, quietly delighted] You may prefer the neat slices. I like the heel. There is a satisfying bite to it, and I do not mind its shape being a little uneven. You need not make an occasion of saving it for me, either. A small piece of bread and a quiet moment are already a very pleasant arrangement.

lore3884_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [soothing friendly invitation, unhurried warmth, gently encouraging] This seems a good place. Sit down, put the work aside for a moment, and enjoy what you have brought. It need not be a grand feast to deserve your attention. A loaf tastes better when you give yourself time to notice it, and I would be glad to hear how you have been while we eat.

lore6746_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere] [affectionate] Your visits have become something I look forward to, my friend. Let us have a little time together without another duty waiting between us. I would be glad simply to hear how you are.
lore6746_befriended_1.ogg.text: Your visits have become something I look forward to, my friend. Let us have a little time together without another duty waiting between us. I would be glad simply to hear how you are.

lore6746_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [welcoming] There you are. Come along, and tell me how you have been. I hope there is something pleasant in the day's news, but you are welcome to share the difficult parts too.
lore6746_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Come along, and tell me how you have been. I hope there is something pleasant in the day's news, but you are welcome to share the difficult parts too.

lore6746_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle] [quietly pleased] Three small good things. That is all I try to remember after a busy day. Someone rested, someone laughed, and a friend came by without needing anything at all.
lore6746_idle_1.ogg.text: Three small good things. That is all I try to remember after a busy day. Someone rested, someone laughed, and a friend came by without needing anything at all.

lore6746_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [reassuring] [calm] Put down what you can for a moment. You have carried the day's work this far. A little rest and good company may help you notice that something pleasant happened along the way too.
lore6746_rest_1.ogg.text: Put down what you can for a moment. You have carried the day's work this far. A little rest and good company may help you notice that something pleasant happened along the way too.

lore8385_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere] [affectionate] Your visits have become something I look forward to, my friend. You need not bring a discovery every time. I would be glad to share a quiet stretch of the road.
lore8385_befriended_1.ogg.text: Your visits have become something I look forward to, my friend. You need not bring a discovery every time. I would be glad to share a quiet stretch of the road.

lore8385_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [thoughtful] I am glad you came. There is much I still hope to understand, but I can put the questions aside for a little while. Tell me how you have been.
lore8385_greet_1.ogg.text: I am glad you came. There is much I still hope to understand, but I can put the questions aside for a little while. Tell me how you have been.

lore8385_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle] [quietly pleased] Such a warm color in that fallen leaf. It need not hold a hidden answer to be worth noticing. Sometimes I gather something simply because it is beautiful.
lore8385_idle_1.ogg.text: Such a warm color in that fallen leaf. It need not hold a hidden answer to be worth noticing. Sometimes I gather something simply because it is beautiful.

lore8385_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [grateful] [hopeful] Thank you for seeing it through. A little help can reach farther than you know. I came to Silverpine hoping to offer some, and I have learned to appreciate receiving it, too.
